notes.title: Update 1.0.2 is here!
notes.notes:
Hello!

The second major update for Laserboy VR is here! 

If you are still on the fence, now is a perfect time to hop into the action! Let's dive in to all the new content releasing today:

UFO 2.0 

 UFOs have been completely reworked. UFO Health is now randomized! 
 As rounds progress, UFOs will become more aggressive, increasing both their movement speed and rate of fire.
 New UFO Behavior: UFOs will now periodically vanish for a second before reappearing in a new 
location. This teleportation-like behavior repeats every few seconds, keeping players on their toes. 


https://media.fab.com/image_previews/gallery_images/57aedd7f-7f5c-40aa-9bca-a2091ad119e7/bbdfb697-7cc6-40f1-b842-6900fbc8dae8.jpg
New Enemy: Drone

A new enemy has arrived – the Drone! Keep an eye on the skies, as this foe will fly and attack from above spawning in with a red-shield for 4 seconds. 

New Power-Up: Quad-Shot
A brand new power-up has been added, giving you the ability to fire four shots at once! This four-shot power-up will help you take down enemies more efficiently. Look for the yellow power-up!


Endless Mode 2.0
Endless Mode has been reworked to ensure each round is unique! A random mix of UFOs, Drones, and power-ups will spawn, keeping the action fresh and exciting. The difficulty will get also increasingly harder every 5 rounds -- Let us know your thoughts! 


Quality of Life Improvements

 Number of UFOs and Drones will always be random!
 Power-Up will now always spawn at random!
 Fixed an issue with Laserbeam colors not always saving!
 Improved enemy hitbox!
 improved explosion VFX!
 Updated store images! (Upgrades now cost 3000 instead of 10000 coins.)


Stay tuned for more updates! Thank you for playing our game.

Tuckspace Games

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 Released
notes.notes:
Hello!

Here is the first official update for Laserboy VR! Introducing...

[previewyoutube=1_zQJY3QlnA;full][/previewyoutube]
Upgrades
You can now use coins to upgrade your maximum HP or slow-time ability via the shop! 
Each upgrade will add +5 health or 10seconds. Upgrade wisely! 
(Default HP: 10  / Default slow-time ability: 5 seconds)

New Power-Up: Shields
Look for the new blue power-up! A shield will spawn and block incoming lasers for 10 seconds. Players can also move and shoot while the shield is active.

UFO Difficulty
We have tweaked current UFO health to be random and slightly modified their spawn + attack patterns. 
We will be monitoring for additional changes!


Quality of Life Updates

 Updated Power-up model to sphere
 Added new blue bar to show the usage of the slow-time ability 
 Reduced hud size by 10%


Feedback
We are always looking for more bug reports and feedback!


Stay tuned for more future updates! Thank you for playing our game.

Tuckspace Games
